items: Who is eligible and whether the offer is limited to one claim per member.
Any minimum qualifying action, maximum benefit or excluded activity.

items.question: How do I find out whether I qualify?
items.answer: Read the eligibility rules for the specific offer. Contact support if you are unsure whether the requirements apply to your account.

items.question: Are the offers on this page currently available?
items.answer: The starting offers on this page are examples. Confirm the current offer details and availability with Arena33 before taking part.

items.question: Where do I claim a bonus?
items.answer: Follow the official link or instructions provided for the offer. This landing page provides information and does not process claims or payments.

items.question: What should I read before accepting an offer?
items.answer: Check eligibility, qualifying requirements, restrictions, benefit limits, play-through conditions and expiry dates.
